title: Formation
description: A football formation defined in the universal coordinate system (see docs/coordinate-systems.md). Legality rules NOT enforceable by JSON Schema (e.g. end-of-line players must be eligible receivers) are documented in docs/formation-rules.md.

personnel.description: Personnel grouping. Offense uses RB-TE shorthand: '21' = 2 RB / 1 TE / 2 WR. Defense uses front-LB shorthand: '4-3', '3-3-5'.

strength_side.description: Side of the formation that's strong (e.g. TE side on offense).

position.description: Position (QB, HB, FB, WR, TE, LT, LG, C, RG, RT, etc.).

x.description: Universal x in yards (positive = offense's right).

on_line.description: True if the player is on the line of scrimmage.

strengths.description: What this formation does well — schemes/situations it's built for.

weaknesses.description: Where this formation struggles — defenses or situations that exploit it.

common_uses.description: Game situations where you'd typically call this formation.

run_concepts.description: Run concepts that pair well with this formation. Names should match concept entries in data/concepts/ when those exist.

pass_concepts.description: Pass concepts that pair well with this formation. Names should match concept entries in data/concepts/ when those exist.

era.description: Era when this formation was/is most commonly used (e.g. '1970s-1990s NFL', 'modern college spread').

famous_users.description: Coaches, teams, or systems known for this formation.

front.description: Defensive front (DL + LB structure). Common values: '4-3', '3-4', '4-2-5', '3-3-5', '46-Bear', 'Nickel-4-2', 'Dime-4-1', 'Goal-Line'. Defense only.

coverage_shell.description: Defensive coverage shell (DB rotation + responsibilities). Common values: 'cover-0', 'cover-1', 'cover-2', 'cover-2-man', 'cover-3', 'cover-4', 'tampa-2', 'cover-6'. Defense only.

aim.description: Where the player goes / what gap or zone they cover.

covers_player.description: For man coverage: label of the offensive player covered (e.g. 'X', 'TE', 'HB').

best_against.description: Offensive concepts this defense handles well. Defense only.

vulnerable_to.description: Offensive concepts that beat this defense. Defense only.
